title: E2 (exploratory): runtime-invoked skill vs free-form agent
hypothesis: A controller that runs the inherited run_tests skill itself and asks the model only for patches beats the free-form loop at the same model and step budget.
finding: Runtime runs run_tests before the first turn and after each edit: 6/8 successes vs 3/8 tools-only at the same 20-step budget (Qwen 4/4, median 9 vs 13.5 steps; LFM 2/4 vs 0/4). Rows are in e1-inheritance.json.
limits: Arm added after the E1 preregistration; one replicate per cell; 4 synthetic tasks. The preregistered rerun (e2-rerun.json) did not support the success claim (3-0, inconclusive); for Qwen it used fewer steps and actions, an exploratory observation (e2-rerun-efficiency.json) that needs its own preregistered test.
